title: Flood Fill
goal: Recolor the starting pixel’s orthogonally connected component of equal-colored pixels.
strategy: Use a queue and mark pixels when enqueuing. Only pixels of the original color join the component; diagonal contact does not connect regions.

phasePurposes.start: Recolor the starting pixel’s orthogonally connected component of equal-colored pixels.
